data.title: 因幡巡 · 夏夜凉风中的指尖相扣
data.description: 深夜安静的公寓阳台上，凉爽的夜风吹散了白日的暑气。巡身着轻柔的居家吊带衫，赤足站在木栏杆旁仰望繁星。当少年的手掌轻轻覆上她搭在栏杆边的指尖时，她没有抽离，而是微红着脸翻过手心，坚定地十指相扣。
data.action: interlocking fingers, looking at stars, shy affectionate smile
data.lighting: cool silver moonlight and ambient city glow
data.promptProse: Standing on a quiet open balcony under the star-studded night sky, Inaba Meguru interlocks fingers with the viewer along the railing. The summer breeze ruffles her soft pink locks and light camisole as she smiles with shy, tender affection.
data.animaCaption: Meguru interlocking fingers gently on the star-lit balcony at night.
